description: This file implements a benchmarking tool for TensorFlow models. It includes functionality to load a graph, run inference multiple times, measure performance metrics such as latency, throughput, and FLOPs estimation. It also supports detailed statistics collection and reporting, as well as initialization and warm-up routines.

classes.name: InputLayerInfo
classes.description: Structure representing input layer details, including name, data type, shape, and initialization values.

classes.name: StatSummarizer
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting and reporting statistics during model benchmarking.

methods.name: absl::Status InitializeVariables(Session * session,const std::vector<std::string> & init_ops)
methods.description: Initializes model variables within a session using specified init operations.

methods.name: void CreateTensorsFromInputInfo(const std::vector<InputLayerInfo> & inputs,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,tensorflow::Tensor>> * input_tensors)
methods.description: Creates input tensors based on input layer information, including data type, shape, and initialization values.

methods.name: absl::Status GetOutputShapes(const std::vector<InputLayerInfo> & inputs,const std::set<std::string> & wanted_shapes,Session * session,std::unordered_map<std::string,TensorShape> * node_shapes)
methods.description: Runs the session to determine the output shapes for specified target nodes based on a set of inputs.

methods.name: absl::Status CalculateFlops(const GraphDef & graph,const std::vector<InputLayerInfo> & inputs,Session * session,int64_t * total_flops,std::unordered_map<std::string,int64_t> * flops_by_op)
methods.description: Estimates the number of floating point operations (FLOPs) for the given graph and inputs.

methods.name: void RecordBenchmarkEntry(const std::string & output_prefix,const std::string & benchmark_name,const std::string & postfix,int num_runs,double total_time_s,double throughput=-1.0)
methods.description: Records benchmarking results such as inference time, throughput, and other metrics.

methods.name: void SleepSeconds(double sleep_seconds)
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: absl::Status InitializeSession(int num_threads,const std::string & graph,std::unique_ptr<Session> * session,std::unique_ptr<GraphDef> * graph_def)
methods.description: Loads the TensorFlow graph and initializes a session for benchmarking.

methods.name: absl::Status RunBenchmark(const std::vector<InputLayerInfo> & inputs,const std::vector<std::string> & outputs,const std::vector<std::string> & targets,Session * session,StatSummarizer * stats,int64_t * inference_time_us)
methods.description: Runs one inference pass of the model and measures its execution time.

methods.name: absl::Status TimeMultipleRuns(double sleep_seconds,int num_runs,double max_time_s,const std::vector<InputLayerInfo> & inputs,const std::vector<std::string> & outputs,const std::vector<std::string> & targets,Session * session,StatSummarizer * stats,int64_t * total_time_us,int64_t * actual_num_runs)
methods.description: Runs multiple inference passes, optionally with sleeps between, and records total timing.
